newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank extends administration of Banerj.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank extends administration of Banerj.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank said it will extend its administration of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj, which expires today, for another 180 days, allowing the bank's privatization process to continue.
The move prevents Banerj from being liquidated or being turned into a federal bank.

Banerj was due to be sold at a privatization auction on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange on Thursday, but the auction was suspended at the last minute for the second time in 10 days due to a court ruling.
The Central Bank took over administration of Banerj in December 1994. Earlier this year, investment bank Bozano, Simonsen was hired to prepare Banerj for privatization.
The Central Bank has yet to decide whether or not Bozano, Simonsen will continue managing Banerj on its behalf since the contract expires at year's end.
The Rio de Janeiro state government hopes the privatization of Banerj will go ahead in January with the publication of a new tender document and an auction toward the end of the month.
Earlier, the Central Bank also extended its administration of Sao Paulo state bank Banespa for 180 days.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
